title: The rise of podcasts
instructions: Wpisz w każdą lukę dokładnie jedno słowo. Skróty typu don't liczą się jako dwa słowa, więc nie są poprawną odpowiedzią. Każda luka to 1 punkt.
text: Twenty years ago, few people had heard {{1}} podcasts. Today, millions listen to them every day, {{2}} matter where they are. Part of their appeal lies {{3}} the fact that they are free and available at any time. Unlike radio, podcasts allow listeners to choose exactly what they want to hear, {{4}} it is history, science or celebrity gossip. {{5}} their popularity, making money from podcasts remains difficult for most creators. Only a small number attract enough listeners to {{6}} able to live off advertising. Many others do it simply {{7}} the love of it, and some have gone {{8}} to build successful careers in the media.
